name: Cabolafuente (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally by a wavy band of yellow and red from the upper hoist to the lower fly, red at the lower hoist and green at the upper fly.
history: Municipal flag of Cabolafuente; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: wavy band of yellow and red stripes from the upper hoist to the lower fly
